EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong ν(C=O) near 1728 cm⁻¹ consistent with an aromatic aldehyde, intense aromatic/alkyl C–H stretches (2963–3115 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003), and a prominent band at 1407 cm⁻¹ matching the ν(NO₂) region for nitro groups (GFQ-022). The strong 859 cm⁻¹ band is characteristic of an NO₂ wag in nitrobenzenes, and the ∼1000 cm⁻¹ ring-breathing mode supports an aromatic ring. The pattern of CH₃ bending near 1445/1407 also fits a methoxy substituent. These features together best match the nitro–methoxy benzaldehyde structure in candidate 1.
